data.description: Captured 2026-09-04 during the session-notification brainstorm (epic allstar-holy-hairstreak). DEFERRED by operator decision: v1 notices are advisory + suppress only; enforcement is out of the notification epic's scope. Design notes: rebar owns exactly one action class (tracker writes: claim/transition/comment/edit/tracker-maintenance), so an Argo CD sync-window-style deny window is feasible there. Mandatory mitigations recorded from the critique: hard max duration (e.g. 8h), read-time expiry, author cancel, human-only force bypass with a break-glass runbook, ADR 0114 advisory-first promotion (ship detect-only, then flip). Risk: agents may never --force, so a fat-fingered window wedges the fleet until a human intervenes.
data.title: Machine-enforced tracker-write freeze notices (deny window on named tracker ops)
